pick.name: Orca (stablyai)
pick.what: Desktop app: parallel Claude Code sessions each in its own git worktree, diff review, GitHub/Linear views, SSH worktrees, mobile companion, notifications
pick.why: Most active open-source worktree orchestrator for Claude Code; MIT, releases near-daily; bring your own Claude plan
pick.free_limits: no paid tier seen; anonymous telemetry on by default (opt-out documented)

alts.name: Built-in agent view + worktrees (claude agents, --worktree, /batch)
alts.what: First-party background sessions, each auto-moved into .claude/worktrees
alts.free_limits: Requires a Claude plan (Pro/Max plans/Team/Enterprise) or API billing; counts against plan usage

alts.name: Claude desktop app parallel sessions
alts.what: GUI parallel sessions with visual diffs
alts.why: First-party GUI if you want no third-party app
alts.free_limits: Requires a Claude plan (Pro/Max plans/Team/Enterprise) or API billing; counts against plan usage

candidates.name: Orca
candidates.verdict: pick: MIT, most active, cross-platform per releases page

candidates.name: Built-in agent view
candidates.verdict: runner-up; wins once it leaves research preview or if you want no third-party app

candidates.name: Conductor
candidates.verdict: macOS-first, proprietary; no confirmed Windows/Linux build

candidates.verdict: macOS only at last check; others planned

candidates.name: Agent teams
candidates.verdict: experimental, off by default; no worktree isolation

decision: Orca wins as the worktree-per-agent desktop app: MIT, near-daily releases, PR/diff review, notifications and a mobile companion. Switch to Claude Code's built-in agent view if Orca's telemetry or hook load is a concern, or once agent view leaves research preview. Do not drive the same repo from both.
details: Orca v1.4.243 (2026-10-28) ships macOS (dmg/zip, arm64 and x64), Linux (deb, rpm, AppImage, arm64 and x64) and Windows (exe) builds. MIT, ~108.8k stars, near-daily releases; anonymous telemetry is on by default with a documented opt-out.

verify.note: Bias check passed on merit: largest adoption in the field (108.8k stars vs Vibe Kanban 28.5k, claude-squad 8.7k AGPL with last release 2026-08-20), MIT, cross-platform, agent-agnostic. Conductor is macOS-only. Keep.
